enchantments.tooltip: Greater Poison Guard: This item carries a potent venom that may be contracted by enemies that hit you, dealing 2d6 Strength damage. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 28) will negate this effect.
Constitution +9: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Resistance +8: Passive: +8 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Proof Against Poison +8: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +8 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).
